## Your application

Image: Rückenansicht Studierende mit Hoodie der HWG LU Congratulations! You have been selected by your home university to study abroad at the Ludwigshafen University of Business and Society.

Before we can welcome you to our university, you must register online.

Please note that we can only process complete applications (with all required documents) received on or before the application deadline.

Application Deadlines
  * Winter Semester: May 15 (Non-EU-students) / May 31 (EU-students)
  * Summer Semester: November 15 (Non-EU-students) / November 30 (EU-students)

STEP 1

First, please register on our online application portal. Under login, create a username and password (minimum 8 signs; 1 special sign required).

Before you start the online application, please prepare the following:

  * a scanned identity photo (JPEG only)
  * a scanned photocopy of your passport (PDF)
Please fill out the online application. Please make sure that you have completed all mandatory fields and uploaded all necessary documents



STEP 2

After you have submitted the application form, please wait until the application file is generated; then please click on “download your application form (PDF)” and print it out. The application form must be signed by the coordinator at your home university.



STEP 3
Once you have obtained the necessary signature, please send the scanned application form together with the other required documents to the following E-Mail address: alexandra.ege@hwg-lu.de Required documents:
